note: Reuse existing ARCH scope (10.product-architecture.srs.md, currently a stub) for cross-cutting concerns. 6 new feature scopes added. Type prefixes (FR/NFR/IR/DR/SEC/PERF/REL/OBS/OPS/MIG/CON) avoided per skill §0.8. All scope prefixes unique and SRS-MD §11.2 compliant.

scopes.name: Product Architecture
scopes.rationale: Cross-cutting product constraints: Electron security baseline (contextIsolation/sandbox/nodeIntegration), CJS vs ESM process model, vendored renderer libs, build & packaging (electron-builder, esbuild bundle), MCP bundle pipeline. Owns OPS/CON/architecture-level requirements that have no single feature home; per-feature security behaviors live in their feature scope.

scopes.name: Application Shell and IPC
scopes.rationale: Electron app lifecycle, single-instance lock, system tray, ndjson IPC socket server (Named Pipe / Unix socket), electron-store settings, contextBridge API, i18n locale loading, Windows .md file association. The central glue of the main process.

scopes.name: Window Management and Navigation
scopes.rationale: BrowserWindow lifecycle, named-window upsert, cascading positions, navigation history, window state tracking, file watchers, sidebar tree load orchestration, severity/auto-close/progress window features.

scopes.name: Sidebar Tree Builder
scopes.rationale: Merged sidebar tree: link-based tree from markdown links/wikilinks + filesystem directory tree, with linked-node marking. Limits MAX_DIR_FILES/MAX_TREE_FILES/MAX_DEPTH.

scopes.name: MCP Server Integration
scopes.rationale: Two MCP transports exposing 6 tools (open_markdown, update_markdown, close_viewer, list_viewers, search_documents, search_projects): stdio server via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk + Zod, and embedded HTTP JSON-RPC 2.0 server (Streamable HTTP, SSE, CORS, OAuth discovery stubs).

scopes.name: Document Persistence and Search
scopes.rationale: Auto-save of MCP documents with subdirectory templating, YAML frontmatter injection/parsing (docType classification), git metadata collection, and BM25 full-text search (Korean+English composite tokenizer) over saved documents.

scopes.name: Renderer and Rendering Pipeline
scopes.rationale: Renderer UI: markdown rendering pipeline (marked -> DOMPurify -> heading IDs -> images -> mermaid -> highlight -> TOC), themes, settings UI, tab-based multi-document view, sidebar file search, PDF export modal, relative image path resolution.
